mapper.select:
select finprod_id as finprodId, finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr from FIN_PRODUCT WHERE 1 = 1 and FINPROD_TYPE in ('F02','F03','F04','F05')
AND (finprod_id like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR finprod_abbr like '%' || #{search} || '%')
GROUP BY finprod_id, finprod_abbr

select a.finprod_id finprodId, b.finprod_name finprodName, a.finprod_type finprodType, a.branch_type branchType, a.branch branchNo, to_char(d.vdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') vdate1, to_char(d.mdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') mdate1, d.basis basis, d.yield*100 yield, c.is_accr_penalty_int ifPenalty, e.is_rush_back ifRushback from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT a left join FIN_PRODUCT b on a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD c on a.finprod_id=c.finprod_id and a.branch=c.branch left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT e on a.finprod_id=e.finprod_id and a.branch=e.branch inner join (select a.finprod_id, a.finprod_type, a.branch, a.cash_id, b.vdate, b.mdate, c.basis, c.yield from FIN_CASH_INFO a left join (select a.cash_id,a.mdate,a.vdate from FIN_CASH_PLAN a, (select cash_id,max(mdate) mdate from FIN_CASH_PLAN group by cash_id) b where a.cash_id=b.cash_id and a.mdate=b.mdate) b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id left join (select a.cash_id, b.eff_date, a.basis, a.yield from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a, (select cash_id, min(eff_date) eff_date from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE group by cash_id) b where a.cash_id = b.cash_id and a.eff_date = b.eff_date) c on a.cash_id = c.cash_id where a.cash_type_2='C19'/*罚息标识*/ ) d on a.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and a.finprod_type = d.finprod_type and a.branch = d.branch where 1=1
and a.finprod_id=#{finprod_id}
and a.finprod_type in
#{finprodType}
AND a.VDATE >= to_date(#{vdateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND a.VDATE <=to_date(#{vdateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND a.MDATE >=to_date(#{mdateBegin},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND a.MDATE <=to_date(#{mdateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
